scope: Three seeds of one still per move. Embedded metadata verifies identical prompts for normal completed jobs. Seed 42 handheld is a latent-decode rescue whose video omits the original inference prompt. These observations do not estimate general reliability.

cases.prompt: A woman in a red coat walks down a wet city street at dusk. The camera makes one continuous smooth dolly in, moving physically forward behind the woman, closing the distance. Buildings expand through parallax. No pull back, no cuts. Quiet city ambience.
cases.observation: Forward tracking, but little evidence of closing distance; subject size stays nearly constant.
